title: Reading Drill — Testing weatherproof book boxes — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Testing weatherproof book boxes — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Bramley began with reports of damp air entering outdoor exchange boxes overnight. The community exchange organiser had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using air sensors and chose humidity inside each box as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was raised vents protected from rain. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted three weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded the type of wood as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
